messages:
Olivia: quick weekly check-in for AtlasCo onboarding — noticed a token + throughput bump over the last 2 weeks. want to align on latency, error rate, and spend before next renewal touch. key asks: current WoW/QoQ trends, any infra flags, recommended quick wins.

Mateo: share of metrics from billing/telemetry: WoW tokens +28% (120k -> 154k requests-equivalent tokens), QoQ +73% (from ~89k a quarter ago). avg tokens/request +15% (users testing longer contexts). platform spend MoM +32%.
p50 latency: 210ms (was 180ms last week), p95: 420ms, p99: 980ms. 5xx error rate rose to 0.36% from 0.12%.

Sophie: infra notes — seeing KV cache miss rate jump (prefix misses) and a lot more single-turn, high-token requests, which reduces batching efficiency. batching histogram shows median batch size down to 3 (from 7). this explains higher p50 and cost. also small spike in tail GC on ded-atlas-1.

Raj: customer context — they onboarded a new chatbot flow last Tue that keeps a long system prompt + multi-step templates, so token size per call increased. they have a training session scheduled Wed that may further increase churn. not flagged as renewal risk yet but high spend catches exec attention.

Olivia: high level plan suggestion: 1) short infra mitigations (cache + batch tuning), 2) CS enablement (prompt trimming, streaming), 3) billing guardrails (soft quota/alerts + temporary credit if needed). who can own infra changes today?

Sophie: I can own infra. plan: enable prefix caching for AtlasCo keys + raise batching window to 40ms for pool `ded-atlas-1` to improve batch sizes. will do a 10% canary first. commands/config I'll apply:```yaml
# targeted change
pool: ded-atlas-1
batch_window_ms: 40
prefix_cache_enabled: true
```
I'll watch KV hit-rate, batch size, and tail latency during rollout.

Mateo: I'll handle the spend side — will prepare a short credit proposal (1 week of reduced invoicing) and send recommended quantization + perf playbook to AtlasCo. also going to enable a spend alert at $X/day (threshold) for their account.

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled by Sophie: rollout `ded-atlas-1` batch_window change -> canary 10% at 2026-03-21T15:10:00Z. Monitor group: @Sophie @Mateo @Olivia

Sophie: rolling now. will post logs and a quick before/after snapshot in ~20m.

Olivia: perfect. follow-ups: Sophie -> post canary metrics + confirm p50/p95 improvement; Mateo -> credit/email + enable billing alert; Raj -> schedule enablement quick call with AtlasCo for prompt best-practices. capturing this for weekly ops note. :thumbsup:
